review:
Half slot, half crash game. Always Up! x10000 plays on a normal 5x3 grid, but the bonus is a rocket launch: several rockets climb into the sky, their multipliers rising as they go, and each one blows up at a random height.

You pick the rocket you think will go highest, and its multiplier when it explodes is applied to your bet. Picking your rocket and watching it climb is genuinely tense. Very high volatility with a 10,490x max and 96.05% RTP – far more upside than the original Always Up!.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
